Bacterium.scope: Accepted catalogued species, including fossil and recently extinct species where covered. Coverage is incomplete; missing extinction flags are unknown, not extant.
Bacterium.interpretation: Conventional named taxon; older functional wording is approximate.

Reptile.scope: Accepted catalogued species, including fossil and recently extinct species where covered. Coverage is incomplete; missing extinction flags are unknown, not extant.

FloweringPlant.scope: Accepted species in the COL26.9 base checklist; fossils included where covered and missing extinction status retained as unknown. Monocots plus dicots in COL; matches the broad NCBI angiosperm lineage.

Invertebrate.scope: Accepted species in the COL26.9 base checklist; fossils included where covered and missing extinction status retained as unknown. A paraphyletic aggregate, not a single clade.

Mammal.scope: Living and recently extinct species (since 1500); domestic species included. Fossil species excluded.

Marsupial.scope: Living and recently extinct species (since 1500); domestic species included. Fossil species excluded. Crown-group component only; the GPT node also includes fossil stem relatives whose count is unavailable.
Marsupial.interpretation: Conventional named taxon; older functional wording is approximate.

Canine.scope: Living and recently extinct species (since 1500); domestic species included. Fossil species excluded.
Canine.interpretation: Conventional named taxon; older functional wording is approximate.

Feline.scope: Living and recently extinct species (since 1500); domestic species included. Fossil species excluded.
Feline.interpretation: Conventional named taxon; older functional wording is approximate.

Primate.scope: Living and recently extinct species (since 1500); domestic species included. Fossil species excluded.

Human.scope: Living and recently extinct species (since 1500); domestic species included. Fossil species excluded.

Fish.scope: Valid fish species in Eschmeyer’s Catalog; no extinction breakdown supplied by the headline statistic.

Virus.scope: MSL41 species excluding the 45 viroids (Pospiviroidae 40; Avsunviroidae 5). Intended as a viral-species proxy for the older protein-coated definition; ICTV also covers satellite viruses and virus-derived entities.

Plant.scope: Accepted catalogued species, including fossil and recently extinct species where covered. Coverage is incomplete; missing extinction flags are unknown, not extant.
Plant.interpretation: Conventional Plantae kingdom, including its algae; the older functional definition does not coincide exactly with this taxon.
